hypotheses.name: boundary-pair
hypotheses.statement: The two theorems are adjacent in parameter and opposite in sign; jointly with Magnus-Peluso (n=3 faithful) and Long-Paton (n>=6 not faithful) they close the question: Burau faithful iff n <= 4.
hypotheses.check: positive theorem: rho_4 faithful. negative theorem: rho_n not faithful for n >= 5. Together with known n=3 and n>=6 results, the threshold is exactly 4. Provenance-verified from abstracts (both text layers).
